units.La refonte de tousimparfaits.com que vou: The tousimparfaits.com rebuild you just walked through, the sixty logo routes next door, the nine-language translation: it's free. No license, no invoice, nothing expected back. Keep it, trash it, slice it into a Shopify theme — it's yours.
units.Le reste de cette page est court : qui j: The rest of this page is short: who I am, why I did it, exactly what's in the box — and what I could possibly help with, with its limits stated plainly.
units.Refonte offerte Une session de travail d: Free rebuild A 17 hr 26 min work session Nothing expected in return Open source, MIT license
units.Un entrepreneur qui aime bricoler des si: An entrepreneur who likes to tinker with websites.
units.Paul, la trentaine, entrepreneur Interne: Paul, in his thirties, internet entrepreneur between New York and Lisbon. I build my own products — an eSIM carrier, a news app — and I advise on two subjects: cybersecurity and applied AI.
units.En hobby, ce que je sais faire de mes ma: As a hobby, here is what I can do with my own hands: sites and apps that convert, automations that hold up over time, databases and team workflows, and audits that find what is about to break before it breaks.
units.Avec mes équipes chez megastack.sh et ca: With my teams at megastack.sh and calliope.agency, we ended up building our own agents for branding, web design and web app development. They already run on my own companies — Openline, cupof.news — and on our clients' projects. What you have in front of you came out of that.
Because I've been following you for a long time.
units.Au printemps 2020, en l’espace de quelqu: In the spring of 2020, within a few months, I lost my mentor and then my father — and the world came to a halt on top of it. I spent a lot of time on the internet that year. Your videos were part of it, and they stayed.
units.Depuis, j’ai regardé la suite se constru: Since then I've watched what came next take shape: the teams following one another, the formats finding their footing, the company growing without ever losing its tone. Right up to everything there is today, Odyssée included.
units.Puis j’ai vu la vidéo où vous expliquez: Then I saw the video where you explain that Tous Imparfaits has to be started over, that the branding isn't keeping up, that no logo works across the whole range. I did what I know how to do, over a weekend, instead of leaving a comment.
units.Il n’y a rien à renvoyer. C’est un cadea: There's nothing to give back. It's a gift in the plain sense of the word: if it's useful to you, so much the better; if it isn't, it wasn't much to give.
units.Ce qui existe aujourd’hui, en ligne, uti: What exists today, online, usable as is or in pieces. It's a static demo, and it says so — the exact scope is spelled out just below.
units.Une page unique, statique, orientée conv: A single static page built to convert: hero, tiered offers, 7 collections, 8 products, featured universes, shop-the-look, Mystery Pack, collaborations, community, FAQ, newsletter. Cart and checkout simulated client-side.
units.HTML / CSS / JS sans dépendance: HTML / CSS / JS with no dependencies
units.Prête à découper en thème Shopify: Ready to cut into a Shopify theme
units.Textes, prix et visuels repris de votre: Copy, prices and visuals taken from your site
units.Trente pour « Tous Imparfaits », trente: Thirty for "Tous Imparfaits", thirty for "Imparfaits", each delivered as a full logo, a favicon from 16 to 48 px, an app icon on three backgrounds and a browser tab. Including the written call: IM / PARFAITS.
units.SVG pur, une seule couleur d’accent: Pure SVG, a single accent colour
units.Français, anglais, japonais, chinois, co: French, English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, German, Dutch, Italian. Instant switching with no reload, cart and checkout included. Browser language detected on the first visit.
units.La livraison est bloquée à la France, et: Shipping is limited to France, and that's fair enough: we're not touching the euros or the stated scope. But people discover and follow a brand long before they can order from it — the day you do open up, the interface won't have any catching up to do.
units.限 Ce que ce showcase est, et ce qu’il n’: 限 What this showcase is, and what it isn't
units.Aucun jugement sur le site actuel : il t: No judgment on the current site: it works, it sells, it has a personality, and there's real work behind it — this isn't a rebuild as a verdict. It's one proposal among other possible ones, to take or to leave.
units.Autant être net tout de suite : ce que v: Let's be clear right away: what you're looking at is a static showcase, made to show the potential of the journey — not a production site. Nothing is connected to real stock, real payments or real orders.
units.Trois vues construites, de bout en bout: Three views, built end to end
units.La landing — hero, offres à paliers, col: The landing page — hero, tiered offers, collections, universes, shop-the-look, social proof, FAQ, newsletter
units.La fiche produit — galerie, tailles, gui: The product page — gallery, sizes, size guide, stock, shipping, add to cart
units.Le panier et le paiement — tiroir de pan: Cart and payment — cart drawer, gift tiers, checkout and payment methods framed to build trust
units.Simulé côté navigateur : le panier vit e: Simulated in the browser: the cart lives in memory, no transaction is possible.
units.Les pages de catégorie et les listings f: Category pages and filterable listings (size, color, universe, availability)
units.Les pages légales et éditoriales, le blo: Legal and editorial pages, the blog, campaign pages
units.Toutes ces vues se déclineraient dans le: All these views would come out of the same system: the grid, the typography and the components already exist.
units.Tout est sur GitHub, en public: Everything is on GitHub, in public
units.Les trois livrables, le code complet, le: The three deliverables, the full code, the nine translation dictionaries and the manifest tracing where every asset comes from. MIT license: clone it, cut it up, resell it, no permission needed. No dependencies, no build step — a static server and it's live.
units.Pas envie de passer par git ? Télécharge: Don't want to deal with git? Download the site archive — the three pages, the fonts, the images and the nine dictionaries, ready to open locally.
units.Les photographies produit et le logo res: The product photographs and the logo remain your property — they’re here to show the rebuild on your real content, and I’ll take them down on request.
units.Ouvrir le dépôt →Télécharger le .zip ↓: Open the repo →Download the .zip ↓
units.Le template s'arrête là où le vôtre comm: The template stops where yours begins. Here are the four steps that follow, in increasing order of commitment — and of independence regained.
units.ATerminer les dernières vuesLes écrans q: AFinish the remaining viewsThe screens still missing for an end-to-end journey: categories, filterable listings, search, customer account, order tracking. Same grid, same typography, same conversion logic as what already exists.
units.BDécouper en thème ShopifyLe template tr: BCut it into a Shopify themeThe template turned into a clean theme: editable sections, reusable blocks, native cart and checkout, metafields for collections and gift tiers. Delivered ready to publish — the natural extension of what’s already here.
units.CHéberger la vitrine chez vous, ne garde: CHost the storefront yourself, keep Shopify through the API onlyThe site moves to your own hosting: faster, no theme to maintain, no template constraints. Shopify shrinks to a back office called through the API — catalogue, stock, orders, payments — while the display, the content and the views are entirely yours.
units.DPuis s'en débarrasserLa suite logique,: DThen drop it altogetherThe logical next step, if the urge comes: Stripe directly (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, SEPA, taxes), an in-house database for catalogue, stock, orders and customers, a clean API, and self-hosted automations. No subscription, no theme commission, the data stays home.

units.Personne n’est parfait. C’est écrit sur: Nobody is perfect. It's been written on your clothes since 2021, and that's exactly why this work was easy to start. Good luck to the whole team.
units.— Paul, à Lisbonne, pour Tous Imparfaits: — Paul, in Lisbon, for Tous Imparfaits.
units.La refonte est offerte, sans contreparti: The rebuild is a gift, with nothing expected in return. As for the rest, my door is open whenever you feel like talking about it.
units.Le code source sur GitHub — MIT: The source code on GitHub — MIT
units.Page personnelle de Paul Fleury, non aff: Personal page by Paul Fleury, not affiliated with Ici Japon Corp or Tous Imparfaits, and not sponsored. The deliverables shown are working concepts built from public content on tousimparfaits.com. The amounts quoted are indicative. Openline and cupof.news are my own companies.
units.Écrivez-moi quand vous voulez: Write to me whenever you like
units.Pas de créneau à réserver ni de formulai: No slot to book and no form to fill in: a message is enough, and I answer as soon as my week allows. Email is the surest route — on messaging apps it is paulfxyz everywhere.
units.Fuseau Europe/Lisbonne ou New York selon: On Europe/Lisbonne or New York time depending on the week. A reply may take a few days, never longer.
units.Je reste à dispo si vous avez besoin d'u: I'm around if you need advice, a technical opinion or a second pair of eyes on what comes next. And if one day you'd like me to actually get my hands on one of those steps, let's talk — no strings, at your own pace.
units.Ce que ça a coûté, pour l’anecdote et pa: What it cost, as an aside and not for invoicing. Somewhere around $600 to $700 in token-equivalent spend across Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google, Alibaba and the rest, and a 17 hr 26 min work session — mine steering, my agents' in production, over a weekend, multitasking with my other projects. Invoiced to Ici Japon Corp: nothing. I mention it to give the scale of the thing, not to claim it. And note in passing: no image was generated — every photograph on these pages is yours, taken from your site.
